---
title: "wrapped fixture: a document-level column page"
filters:
  - wrapped
column: page
format:
  html: default
  pdf:
    keep-tex: true
---

With `column: page` in the document, Quarto makes each figure float
page-wide, a cell's float with its own `fig-column: body` included. A
wrapped float keeps its normal layout with a warning. A captioned image with
no id is not a float, so it stays in the body and wraps.

## A cell

```{r}
#| label: fig-col-cell
#| fig-cap: "A cell figure in a column page document."
#| classes: wrap-right
plot(1:10)
```
